measurements.name: waist_to_underarm
measurements.label: Waist to underarm
measurements.note: Vertical distance from the waist up to the underarm: HPS → waist (back_neck_drop + back_waist_length) minus HPS → underarm (shoulder_drop + armhole_depth).

measurements.name: cap_height
measurements.label: Sleeve cap height
measurements.note: Set-in sleeve cap height (not used by the set-in template, which fits the cap to the armhole).

measurements.name: underarm_co
measurements.label: Underarm cast-on
measurements.note: Width cast on at each underarm to join front and back (cm, front and back together: half each). Top-down, shoulders-first tops.

measurements.name: cap_ease
measurements.label: Sleeve cap ease
measurements.note: How much longer the cap edge is than the armhole it is sewn into (cm, both sides together).

measurements.name: waist_shift
measurements.label: Waist shift (back → front)
measurements.note: Share of the bust-to-waist narrowing taken by the back: back waist = waist/2 + ease/2 − waist_shift, front waist = waist/2 + ease/2 + waist_shift.

panels.name: Back
panels.notes: Shoulders first: cast on at the shoulders and work flat to the underarm; the front shoulders are picked up from this cast-on edge.

panels.name: Front
panels.notes: Shoulders first: each shoulder is picked up from the back, worked flat with the neck increases; the centre is cast on to join the two sides, and the underarms are cast on to join the back.

joins.name: Front shoulders picked up from the back
joins.note: Pick up along the back shoulders (cast-on edge), one stitch per cast-on stitch; work each front shoulder flat.

joins.name: Underarm cast-on
joins.note: Cast on half the underarm stitches on the front and half on the back to join them.
